lines.l: Sirens on the rooftops wailing, but there's no ships sailing.
Groucho, when there's movies trailing, stands alone with his punchline failing.
Two clerks glance at hot soul food, and the band plays in the mood.
The cheerleader waves a cyanide wand
There's a smell of peach blossom and bitter almond
Carl Chessman sniffs the air and leads the parade
He knows, innocent, you can bottle all you made
There's Howard Hughes in blue suede shoes
Smiling at the majorette smoking Winston cigarettes
And as the song and dance begins
You see the face on the TV screen
